name: Huemul
desc: An endangered Andean deer of scrub and forest borders. Lenga is a common item in its diet, and the puma is its only natural predator.
about: The south Andean deer, also known as the southern guemal, south Andean huemul, southern huemul, or Chilean huemul or güemul ( WAY-mool, Spanish: [weˈmul]), is an endangered species of deer native to…
